<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates that break a ketone and an alkyne (functional groups lost in the forward reaction), form a C‑C bond, and break a C‑O bond, matching the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkyne"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"]
}</action_input>
